name: Vanderburgh County, IN
findings: Vanderburgh County has 748 nonprofit organizations. 296 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 245 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Vanderburgh County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 13 professional organizations here list public events, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 62 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
